subject: Confirmation of Your Flight Booking
body: Dear [Name], We are writing to confirm your upcoming flight booking from New York to Los Angeles on June 15th. Your flight is scheduled to depart at 10:00 AM from JFK Airport. Please make sure to arrive at the airport at least two hours before departure for check-in. If you have any questions or need assistance, feel free to contact our customer service team. We look forward to welcoming you on board. Safe travels, The Flight Booking Team
